title: Tropical Storm Imelda forming and expected to become hurricane
summary: Forecast track could take storm, which caused disruption in Bahamas and Cuba, away from US east coast Tropical Storm Imelda formed on Sunday and was expected to become a hurricane on a forecast track that could take it away from the US east coast in the coming days. The storm was causing disruption in the Bahamas and Cuba on Sunday, and a tropical storm watch was posted in parts of Florida . Meanwhile, Hurricane Humberto weakened very slightly but remained a strong category 4 storm in the Atlantic, threatening Bermuda. Continue reading...

title: Moldova’s ruling pro-European party pulls ahead in pivotal election
summary: PAS leads with 44% of vote in ballot that will decide whether country steers closer to EU or Russia Moldova’s ruling pro-European party has pulled ahead in Sunday’s pivotal election which will decide whether the country of 2.4 million stays on its path towards EU membership or drifts back into Moscow’s orbit. With almost two-thirds of the ballots counted, the pro-western Action and Solidarity party (PAS) led with 44% of the vote, while a Moscow-leaning alliance of Soviet-nostalgic parties headed by former president Igor Dodon had 27%.
